reconstruction_policy: No changes to source bytes, grids, solver precision, physical time steps or native horizons. Explicit organizer sensors and Channel class defaults PLUS the documented local actuator-clock repair are frozen separately from paper/YAML claims.

reference_training_budget.algorithm: shared task-conditioned PPO, 256x256 MLP; optimizer on CPU, native CFD on one H100
reference_training_budget.full_evaluation_scope: Sum of individual cold frozen-policy native replays; not a measured single shared checkpoint suite run
reference_training_budget.time_status: Longer training times extrapolated from measured short PPO updates and full native replays, with 25% planning reserve. Not a guaranteed learning outcome or wall-clock upper bound.
